label: q fed back as input near the end of the copy phase (sparse subset)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase. About 94% of activation mass is on steps where the fed-back input is the letter q. It is concentrated on the last or second-to-last output (to_go 0 or 1 holds about 94% of mass). Rates are highest for L=9 (t=16,17), L=6 (t=11) and L=3 (t=5). It never fires for L=4 and almost never for L=5. Never active in the original or delimiter phases. Only a small fraction of late copy-phase q inputs activate it (precision about 5%), and no per-step or history variable tested (L, position, digit count) separated active from inactive q steps; within L subsets precision stays at or below 0.23. A few weak activations fall on other inputs (x, 3, i, l). Activations are tiny (max 0.014). The top examples are all q inputs at the final copy steps.
